question: Find the display names of users who placed a bounty of 100 on posts that are not well-finished and have the highest view count among all such posts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON u.XCL_052 = ph.XCL_017
JOIN posts p ON ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
WHERE ph.XCL_019 = '100'
  AND p.XCL_044 IS NULL
  AND p.XCL_030 = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.XCL_030)
    FROM posts p2
    JOIN postHistory ph2 ON p2.XCL_026 = ph2.XCL_014
    WHERE ph2.XCL_019 = '100'
      AND p2.XCL_044 IS NULL
  )
